summary.title: AI Anti Fraud 3.0 · iOS data flow
summary.description: The iOS app keeps the mobile investigation flow inside one process. The user question enters through the SwiftUI screen or the custom URL entry point. The bundled llama.cpp model returns a SQL tool call, the parser extracts the query, SQLite returns rows, and the same TinyLLama interprets those rows into the natural-language answer shown to the user.
